codeReview.summary: The React migration delivers the contracted dashboard CRUD, widget picker/search, drag+resize grid, widget context actions, debounced autosave, local backup, and dashboards API sync, with focused Playwright coverage. One non-blocking parity regression was found versus the legacy page.

issues.description: Widget cards are no longer keyboard-operable (legacy supported Delete and Arrow keys on focused cards). The new React card is not focusable and has no key handlers, so this is a parity/accessibility regression outside current validation criteria.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker skill still marks scoped Playwright validation as a deviation in practice because Step 5 says to run full e2e suite, even though migration milestones allow scoped specs. This creates avoidable 'followedProcedure=false' handoffs.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff.skillFeedback.followedProcedure=false for worker session aa014cd9-ecfc-4d7c-bf91-24496282281e; SKILL.md Step 5 says run full suite while the same file's 'Migration Milestone Validation Note' allows scoped validation during partial migration.

summary: Feature passes contract-level scrutiny with strong implementation and test coverage. Noted one non-blocking regression (lost keyboard widget controls) and one skill-procedure clarity gap around scoped vs full Playwright runs.
